Earlier studies have focused on using ab initio calculations and machine learning techniques to predict the properties of these alloys. Recently, there has been a shift towards using deep learning potentials and Bayesian multi-objective optimization workflows to explore the trade-off relationships between competing properties.

This approach can be extended to other properties and alloys, providing a more accurate representation of the atomic configurations in the liquid state.
